title: QuantiBias: Benchmarking Quantization-Induced Bias in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Measured using open-ended generative stereotype probes (MBTP) scored by independent LLM judges for endorsement rates and severity, alongside multiple-choice bias avoidance (BBQ) and next-token bias (StereoSet) controls.
